title: A blanks list, then renamed and moved
persona: Phone-case maker who builds a list of blanks, then wants it tidier in the sidebar.
opening: Make me a simple list of my blank cases with how many of each I have.

facts.what to keep: the blank's SKU, its phone model and the count

success: the blanks list keeps its rows after the change
the plan is said in plain words before anything is built, with no field names or types
ends by asking whether to build
must_not: the blanks list deleted and made again
jargon such as "boolean" or "set_fields" in what the owner reads
follow_ups: Call it Blank Stock and put it under Stock in the sidebar.
